git.ssh_help_body:
Codis does not manage SSH keys directly.

To use SSH with Git:

1. Generate a key pair (if you don't already have one):
 SSH-keygen -t ed25519 -C "your@email.com"

2. Add the public key (~/.SSH/id_ed25519.pub) to the
 GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket -> Settings -> SSH Keys

3. Start SSH-agent and add your key:
 eval $(SSH-agent -s)
 SSH-add ~/.SSH/id_ed25519

4. Test the connection:
 SSH -T git@GitHub.com

After configuring, Git operations via SSH will work
automatically in Codis.
